notes.title: Apply for Demo Playtest!
notes.content: [h1]⚔️ [b]Legacy of Valor - Apply for Play Test! [/b]⚔️[/h1][p][/p][h2]Official gameplay trailer is now live, showcasing [b]Legacy of Valor[/b] a medieval RPG created by a solo developer.[/h2][p][/p][h3]🎬 Watch the trailer here:  [/h3][previewyoutube="wLJ2wWglZuo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]🧪 Become a playtester:  [/h3][p]We're currently accepting applications for our upcoming [b]demo playtest[/b]. Be among the first to try the game and help shape its future.[/p][p][/p][h3]👉 Join our Discord and apply here: [/h3][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/ykYjpqvCUG" style="button"]Discord Link[/url][/p][h3]💥 Kickstarter is launching soon![/h3][p]Your support now means a lot. Help us build something special together.[/p][p][/p][h3]🛡️ Your story. Your legacy.[/h3]
